senses.gloss: m. pl. (preced.) exchange, adaptation of a name of a Persian festive season and fair (cmp. אַקְנַיָּיתָא).
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11b:7">Ab. Zar. 11ᵇ</cite> (Ms. M. <cite ref="M00432"><he>מוֹהֲרָן</he></cite>; ed. Ven. a. oth. <he>מהורן</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Y. ib. I, 39ᶜ <cite ref="M00834"><he>מְחוֹרֵי</he></cite> a Babylonian season.
